summary: Regression pass for XML-RPC timeout/retry fix in odoo_migrate.py (_TimeoutTransport/_TimeoutSafeTransport 120s, _authenticate 5x retry, call() 6x retry+re-auth). Backend: POST /api/admin/sync/start -> 200 (new run_id), GET /api/admin/sync/runs/{id} polled to status 'done' in ~20s with NO error and progress buckets present (catalogs, users, templates, leads, lead_messages, wa_channels, wa_messages, contacts, open_activities). GET /api/admin/sync/status -> 200 with last_sync populated. Frontend: admin login -> Admin > Migration tab -> sync-now-button opens sync-confirm-modal -> sync-confirm-button starts run; sync-progress panel renders; button label lifecycle 'Sync Now' -> 'Sync in progress…' -> back to 'Sync Now' within ~8s; green '✅ Sync #17 complete — 0 new, 142 updated' summary with per-entity counts visible; 'Sync complete' toast fired. No regression from the XML-RPC hardening.
critical_code_review_comments: _TimeoutTransport uses socket.setdefaulttimeout via a per-request context — the 120s timeout is applied consistently across auth + call; combined with 5x auth retry and 6x call retry with re-auth this correctly guards against indefinite XML-RPC hangs.
Consider surfacing the effective timeout via env var (e.g. ODOO_XMLRPC_TIMEOUT) so prod can tune without a redeploy; currently hardcoded at 120s.

Retry backoff on call() should cap total wall time (~<= worker heartbeat budget) to avoid the outer worker still being killed on a persistently degraded Odoo — worth logging cumulative retry time for observability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview Odoo is healthy so the production XML-RPC hang / worker-restart cannot be reproduced here; verified NO REGRESSION only. Delta sync completes in ~8s in preview and returns full per-entity progress. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_odoo_sync_regression.py for future regressions.
rca of the issue: Prod ServerProxy was created without a socket timeout; a hung Odoo request stalled the sync worker until the platform killed the process, surfacing to UI as 'sync worker no longer running'. Fix layers a 120s socket timeout on the XML-RPC transport plus retry-with-reauth so transient XML-RPC failures self-heal instead of hanging the worker.
